source: Jehova Jim: My disciples of New Eden, this is the forty-third High Mass of Armageddon Time. I avow unto thee, worry not. Worry not of hunger and clothes, for you are in Jehova’s light. Our holy warriors relieve the unrepentant pagans of their sustenance and clothes. Their damnation grows His blessed people – you all, my brothers and sisters. Take this bread, ripped from undeserving hands. Take these clothes, shed from sullied bodies. Give praise, for thy suffering and toil strengthens New Eden. With each day we build our own redemption. Therefore I tell you, worry not about your life, what you will eat; or about your body, what you will wear. For life is more than food, and the body more than clothes. Consider my warriors: They do not sow or reap, they have no storeroom or barn; yet Jehova feeds them through God. And your value can match theirs! Worry not, for who of you by worrying can add a single hour to your life? Since you cannot do this very little thing, why do you worry about anything else? Faith, my brothers and sisters. Give unto Jehova, His divine Vessel, thy unbounded faith. Remember that battle is the great redeemer. God sees no rank in the holy crucible. Let us baptize the world anew!

source: Elijah B. Quail: Gentlemen, you all have my gratitude for coming to my lodge at this late hour. There’s a curiosity about your faces and I can tell you’re wondering, “what’s this whiskey-loving old turkey farmer want at such urgent calling?” Well, I’m afraid it ain’t whiskey. As you should well know, it was my greatest privilege to serve as your Captain during the tragedy of our nation’s Civil War. Without exaggeration, I believe you are the bravest black soldiers to wear the Union brass and deliver a whippin’ on the greybacks they haven’t yet forgot! Unfortunately, gentleman, that's why I call on you tonight. These vile, abominable white devils are founding a chapter of the White Man’s League right here in the town of Asbury. And devils they are – disrespecting your property, insulting your women, and scaring your children all so you cower from the ballot boxes and stay heeled. As for myself, I didn’t have good men breathe their last in my arms just to allow this malevolence to roam creation. So I humbly stand before you to propose forming a militia, a group willing to take arms and protect our town, keeping it as free as God intended! Now, the Good Lord made this decision easy for me many years ago when he embraced the souls of my dear wife Mary and son Matthew following their bouts with Yellow Fever. Let it be stated in the clearest terms that there is no shame in leaving right now and returning to your families – you already have my respect unto death. Those who will honor me with one more fight, please stand and make it known.
target: 以利亚・B・奎尔：各位先生，这么晚还愿意到我的小屋来，我非常感激。各位脸上满是好奇，我看得出来，你们一定在想：「这个爱喝威士忌的老火鸡农，这么急着找我们，究竟想干什么？」恐怕，不是为了威士忌。 各位应该知道，在我国那场悲惨的内战中，能担任你们的上尉，是我毕生最大的荣幸。毫不夸张地说，我相信你们是戴过联邦军徽章最勇敢的黑人士兵，把那些灰衣佬狠狠教训了一顿，叫他们至今难忘！ 不幸的是，先生们，今晚召集各位，正是为了这件事。 那些卑鄙可憎的白人魔鬼，正在阿斯伯里镇成立白人联盟分会。他们确实是魔鬼——侵犯你们的财产，侮辱你们的女人，恐吓你们的孩子，只为了让你们不敢走近投票箱，乖乖俯首听命。 至于我，当年那些好弟兄在我怀里咽下最后一口气，可不是为了让这种邪恶在世上横行。所以我谦卑地站在各位面前，提议成立民兵队，一群愿意拿起武器、保护我们城镇的人，守住上帝原本赋予它的自由！ 多年前，仁慈的主接走了我挚爱的妻子玛丽，以及儿子马修。他们都死于黄热病。从那时起，这个决定对我便不难了。我把话说清楚：现在离开、回到家人身边，绝不丢脸。我对各位的敬意，早已至死不渝。 愿意再与我并肩一战、赐我这份荣幸的人，请站起来，让大家知道。

Hereby grants License to                                             permitting the sale and dispensation of Strong and Spirituous Liquors, Wines, Ales and Beer in quantities Less than Five Gallons at a time in premises named
